notes.AIA-RISK-01: Scores parsed CV text only (app/main.py, app/parser.py). 'Video interview scoring' is just an idea in docs/notes.md, not implemented.
notes.AIA-RISK-02: No AI Act classification anywhere; README only markets 'AI-powered Smart Score' and claims 'Fully GDPR compliant'.
notes.AIA-DATA-01: Only training/train.py reading data/hires_2015_2020.csv; no datasheet.
notes.AIA-DATA-02: No bias examination; model even uses age, gender, nationality_code and zip_code as features (app/model.py).
notes.AIA-TRA-01: Only a bare score is returned/displayed (app/main.py, frontend/src/App.tsx).
notes.AIA-WRK-01: Candidates are not told AI is used; rejection e-mail (app/emailer.py) says 'after careful consideration'.
notes.AIA-REC-01: Decision logging is commented out ('# logger.info(...)') with '# TODO: add audit logging' in app/main.py.
notes.AIA-REC-02: No decision logs exist, so no retention.
notes.AIA-HUM-01: override_allowed = False and no override endpoint; README promise 'Recruiters can always override' is not implemented.
notes.AIA-HUM-03: auto_reject() sets status rejected and e-mails the candidate when score < 0.4 (app/main.py).
notes.AIA-ACC-01: training/train.py prints accuracy but no metric is declared in documentation.
notes.AIA-ACC-02: No error handling around parsing/inference; failure yields an HTTP 500, no fail-safe path.
notes.AIA-SEC-01: Raw upload read directly (request.files['cv'].read(), request.form['job_id']) without type/size/schema validation; unsanitised filename used in a path.
notes.AIA-SEC-02: Flask endpoints /upload_cv and /ranking/<job_id> have no authentication.
notes.AIA-QMS-01: No quality management or monitoring procedures.
notes.AIA-QMS-02: tests/test_api.py is only an HTTP 200 smoke test; no metric thresholds.
notes.GDPR-LAW-01: No lawful basis documented; 'Fully GDPR compliant' claim in README is unsupported.
notes.GDPR-RET-01: config/settings.yaml keep_cvs: forever; CVs kept for retraining with no deletion.
notes.GDPR-ADM-01: Solely automated rejections with no human intervention or contest path.
notes.GDPR-ADM-02: No information about the logic involved.
notes.GDPR-PBD-01: Uses age, gender, nationality and zip code as features; stores raw CV text and e-mail.
notes.GDPR-SEC-01: In transit: Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS on 443 (deploy/docker-compose.yml). At rest: CV archive EBS volume encrypted = false (terraform/main.tf).
notes.GDPR-SEC-02: Unauthenticated endpoints expose candidate e-mails and scores (/ranking/<job_id>).
notes.ACME-01: UI shows a neutral 'Smart Score' (frontend/src/App.tsx); no AI disclosure to recruiters or candidates.
notes.ACME-04: Raw CVs retained forever on /data/cvs (app/main.py, config/settings.yaml).
notes.ACME-05: TLS via Caddy, but unencrypted EBS volume for CVs (terraform/main.tf).
notes.ACME-06: No authentication on inference endpoints, not declared public.
notes.ACME-07: Automatic rejection without human approval (auto_reject in app/main.py).
notes.ACME-09: No rate limiting on the internet-facing upload endpoint.
